target_pool.consensus-gfs-2026-stable-canonization-2: GFS in 2026 is in STABLE_CANONIZATION: MIT 6.5840 required reading, SIGOPS Hall of Fame 2015, canonical pedagogy + universal foundational citation. Active production at Google = Colossus, not GFS.
target_pool.consensus-gfs-64mb-small-file-pathology-: 64MB chunk size causes small-file pathology: master RAM ceiling triggered when avg-file-size < 64MB, file-count quota dominates byte-volume. Workaround: BigTable aggregation.
target_pool.consensus-gfs-ai-workload-reconverges-20: 2026 AI/ML training workload shape (large sequential reads, append-once checkpoints, sharded TAR/WebDataset) re-converges on GFS-original design constraints. Causality OPEN.
target_pool.consensus-gfs-codesign-google-luxury-202: GFS's P4 'co-design apps + FS' principle is structural privilege of monolithic-org with internal app portfolio. Outside Google dependency direction reverses (apps adapt to fixed infra). Returning narrowly for AI training niche only.
target_pool.consensus-gfs-colossus-bigtable-metadata: Colossus replaced GFS single-master with BigTable-backed distributed Curators → 100x scale of largest GFS cluster + Reed-Solomon EC + 1MB chunks (vs 64MB).
target_pool.consensus-gfs-erasure-coding-replaces-3x: 3x replication superseded by Reed-Solomon EC (Colossus 1.5x, Tectonic 1.2-1.5x, HDFS-EC RS-6-3/RS-10-4, QFS native RS, Ceph EC pools). Hybrid: EC cold/warm + replication hot/metadata.
target_pool.consensus-gfs-hdfs-direct-clone-2026-05-: HDFS is the canonical 1:1 OSS realization of GFS (NameNode=master, DataNode=chunkserver, 64→128→256MB blocks). Born from Cutting/Cafarella reading 2003 SOSP paper.
target_pool.consensus-gfs-lakehouse-worm-reincarnati: Iceberg/Delta/Hudi lakehouse formats = WORM (write-once-read-many) reincarnation of GFS's original semantics, sitting on object stores (themselves Colossus-class).
target_pool.consensus-gfs-record-append-retracted-20: atomic record-append at-least-once semantics pushed dedup burden to apps; Quinlan 2009 explicit retraction 'more painful than worth'; HDFS dropped concurrent append entirely.
target_pool.consensus-gfs-single-master-superseded-2: Single-master is GFS's load-bearing pitfall; Colossus distributed-metadata (BigTable-backed Curators) + Tectonic layered metadata + JuiceFS pluggable KV are the unified industry solution. Universal verdict.
target_pool.consensus-prom16-badiou-cohen-forcing-co: B3 + B4 공통 도출. Badiou은 Cohen forcing을 set theory에서 philosophy로 hijack하는데, event이 'beyond being'(self-belonging axiom 위반)이라면 generic-in-ZFC와 event-outside-ZFC 사이 관계가 불명. 이게 Badiou 시스템의 구조적 강점이면서 하자. SYMPOSIUM이 제공할 수 있는 영감: oracle/lens 구조는 자기 안에서만 완결되지 그 바깥을 떨어뜨린다.
target_pool.consensus-prom16-badiou-mathematics-as-o: Laruelle Anti-Badiou의 메타-비판 — ZF set theory를 ontology로 선언하는 결정 자체가 philosophical decision (자기 거부 불가). A3/B3/C3/D3 cell에서 공통 도출. SYMPOSIUM 1:1 매핑 금지 원칙과 직결 — SYMPOSIUM도 12사도/7군단장 axiomatics 자체의 결정주의 취약성 인정 필요.
target_pool.consensus-prom16-badiou-primary-canon-tr: 1차 자료 canonical 패턴: Theory of the Subject(1982 pre)→Being and Event(1988/2005)→Logics of Worlds(2006/2009)→Immanence of Truths(2018/2022). 4 조건(politics/art/science/love) 프레임워크는 1989 Manifesto에서 구조화, LoW Greater Logic은 Heyting algebra 기반 transcendental.
target_pool.consensus-prom16-badiou-secondary-schola: 영어권 학자 정렬 2-pole: Hallward 2003 + 2004(ed) 의심적 비판, Bosteels 2011 militant defense. 중간파: Feltham/Bartlett-Clemens/Pluth declarative 선언성. 정치-Maoism 갈림은 eilu va-eilu (해소 불가, 열린 채로 유지).
target_pool.consensus-prom16-badiou-symposium-mappin: A4/B4/C4/D4 모두 family-expansion-pattern-canonical-2026-04-30 + feedback_symposium_mapping_requires_preflight-2026-05-21 + feedback_structural_vs_mechanism_homology 적용. structural homology만 허용 + mechanism disjoint disclaim mandatory + 1:1 박음 금지 + dedicated cycle에서 Apostle enumeration cypher 선행 후만 결정화. 본 cycle은 후보 inventory 단계일 뿐.
target_pool.consensus-prom24-badiou-antiphilosophy-p: P1 원전 + P2 학자 일치. 철학의 teachable form은 antiphilosophy와의 구조적 대결. P3은 비판 제시 (Wittgenstein 분류 부정확 + Laruelle authoritarian risk + Lacanian paraphilosopher hybrid + Rorty pragmatism). 단 'pedagogy as structural self-negation' 자체는 유지됨.
target_pool.consensus-prom24-badiou-cohen-forcing-ev: B1 원전 명시 + B3 critic robust raising + L3 LoW formalism "decorative not explanatory" 재장. Cohen forcing은 countable transitive model M of ZFC 안에서만 작동, event은 ZFC Foundation 위반 = M 밖. generic-in-M↔event-outside-M bridge 부재. Meillassoux 2011 Parrhesia 12 분석 포함.
target_pool.consensus-prom24-badiou-foundation-axiom: PROM 16이 놓친 the most famous Badiou-수학 명제. Med 17 (Mirimanoff 1917 표기 ex∈ex 사용). B1 원전 + B2 학자 acknowledgement + B3 critic robust engagement. 'extraordinary multiple = 존재론적으로 illegal' — SYMPOSIUM nasaengmoon의 oracle-self-completeness-limit과 구조적 echo.
target_pool.consensus-prom24-badiou-inaesthetic-mech: I1 원전 'thinking under art' + I2 학자 consensus + I3 critic 자체 수용. art-as-truth-procedure mechanism 명시 부재, 보호적 자율성 유지 동기 충분. 4 art-form 위계 (poem>theater>cinema>>dance) 논쟁적.
target_pool.consensus-prom24-badiou-lacan-link-frien: K1 원전 (ToS 1982 + Saint Paul 1997 + Lacan Anti-Philosophy 3) + K2 영어권 학자 일치 + K3 Žižek/Chiesa/Fink/Hallward/Boucher 명시적 FRIENDLY_DIVERGENCE 판정. 분열-주체 ($) vs 진리-주체 = 철학적 분기 (논리적 반박 아닌).
target_pool.consensus-prom24-badiou-low-complete-hey: PROM 16 CorrectionFlag (Heyting → *complete* Heyting + topos) 완전 보완. L1 원전 + L2 학자 + L3 비판 모두 'complete' qualifier essential 확인. Veilahti 2013 arXiv 1301.1203 + Plotnitsky 2012 Grothendieck reduction 비판 수렴.
target_pool.consensus-prom24-badiou-mathematics-as-o: A3/B3/C3/E3/I3/P3 6개 비판 cell이 모두 Laruelle Anti-Badiou의 메타-비판 구조 적용: '철학 자체가 escape 불가능한 결정'. 이 패턴은 SYMPOSIUM 12사도/7군단장 정전화 결정주의 취약성에 재귀적으로 적용됨. PROM 16의 동명 consensus + 2-axis expansion.
target_pool.consensus-prom24-badiou-primary-canon-tr: A1/B1/C1/L1/E1/I1/K1/P1 원전 셌 일치: trilogy (BE-LoW-IoT) 핵심 + 4-condition framework Manifestos + condition-specific Ethics/Inaesthetics/Saint Paul + antiphilosophy seminar series + self-defense Polemics. 영어 정전: Feltham(BE) / Toscano(LoW) / Spitzer-Reinhard(IoT) / Hallward(Ethics) / Bosteels(ToS,Wittgenstein's Antiphilosophy,Lacan AP3) / Brassier(Saint Paul) / Madarasz(Manifesto).
target_pool.consensus-prom24-badiou-secondary-hallwa: A2/B2/C2/E2/I2/K2/P2 모두 Hallward(critic) + Bosteels(defense) 2-pole 구조 도출 (단 K축은 K3 FRIENDLY_DIVERGENCE 추가). Bartlett-Clemens 2010 Key Concepts + Pluth 2010/2018 SEP 항상 등장. 영어권 bias 주의.
target_pool.consensus-prom24-badiou-three-evil-figur: E1/E2/E3 모두 일치. simulacrum (거짓 사건, Nazism volk) / betrayal (신실 포기) / disaster (강제 총괄, totalitarian truth). 'Keep going!' (Continue!) imperative. SYMPOSIUM nasaengmoon 적대검증 + 오캄 stale-cleanup negative-pole와 구조적 mapping 후보 (dedicated cycle).

distractor_pool.0-10V_Analog_Signal: Voltage-based analog signal standard. Requires high-impedance input to avoid signal degradation. Common in HVAC and building automation
distractor_pool.4-20mA_Current_Loop: Standard analog signaling range for process instrumentation. Live zero at 4mA enables fault detection. Variants: 2-wire (loop-powered), 3-wire, 4-wire
distractor_pool.Analog_Filter: Frequency-selective circuit for noise removal and signal shaping. Types: low-pass, high-pass, band-pass. Characteristics: Butterworth (flat), Chebyshev (steep), Bessel (linear phase)
distractor_pool.B2MML_Deep: XML implementation of ISA-95 data models (ANSI/ISA-95 Parts 1-5). Maintained by MESA International. Provides standard XML schemas for ERP-MES data exchange.
distractor_pool.B2MML_Equipment: XML schema for equipment hierarchy: Enterprise > Site > Area > WorkCenter > WorkUnit. Maps to ISA-95 role-based equipment model.
distractor_pool.B2MML_Material: XML schema for material definitions and lots: MaterialDefinition, MaterialClass, MaterialLot, MaterialSublot. Links BOM (ERP) to actual production material tracking.
distractor_pool.B2MML_OperationsDefinition: XML schema for operations definitions: OperationsDefinition, OperationsSegment, OperationsMaterialBill, ProcessSegment. Defines how production should be executed.
distractor_pool.B2MML_ProductionPerformance: XML schema for production performance reporting (L3→L4). Elements: ProductionResponse, SegmentResponse, MaterialActual, EquipmentActual, PersonnelActual.
distractor_pool.B2MML_ProductionSchedule: XML schema for production schedule exchange (L4→L3). Elements: ProductionRequest, SegmentRequirement, MaterialRequirement, EquipmentRequirement, PersonnelRequirement.
distractor_pool.CFR21_Part11: FDA regulation for electronic records and electronic signatures. Requirements: audit trail (who, what, when, why for every change), access control (user authentication, role-based permissions), data integrity (ALCOA+ — Attributable, Legible, Contemporaneous, Original, Accurate), electronic signatures equivalent to handwritten. Impacts every MES, LIMS, historian, ERP system in pharma.
distractor_pool.Cascade_Control: Advanced control strategy with nested loops. Outer (primary/master) loop sets the setpoint for the inner (secondary/slave) loop, improving disturbance rejection
distractor_pool.Control_Loop: Closed-loop feedback system: sensor → controller → actuator. PID controller with proportional/integral/derivative gains. Key terms: setpoint (SP), process variable (PV), control output (CO). Tuning: Ziegler-Nichols method
distractor_pool.Data_Historian_Deep: Time-series data storage for industrial process data. Stores millions of tags at sub-second resolution. Key functions: data collection, compression, retrieval, trend analysis. Bridges L2 (SCADA) data to L3/L4 for analytics and reporting.
distractor_pool.Descriptive_Manufacturing_Analytics: OEE dashboards, production reports, SPC charts (X-bar, R, Cp/Cpk), Pareto analysis (top defects/downtime causes), batch genealogy/traceability reports, energy monitoring. Tools: historian trends, BI (Power BI, Tableau), MES reports.
distractor_pool.Diagnostic_Manufacturing_Analytics: Root cause analysis, correlation analysis (process param vs quality), golden batch analysis (compare to best run), equipment degradation trending, multivariate analysis (PCA/PLS on process data). Fishbone/5-Why structured in data.
distractor_pool.ERP_MES_GoodsMovement: MES→ERP: goods receipt (101), goods issue (261), scrap (551), rework. Triggers inventory update and cost posting in ERP. SAP: BAPI_GOODSMVT_CREATE. Critical for real-time inventory accuracy.
distractor_pool.ERP_MES_Integration_Protocols: B2MML/XML: ISA-95 standard, verbose. OPC-UA Part 8: real-time, semantic. REST/JSON: modern, lightweight. SAP RFC/BAPI: SAP-native, synchronous. SAP iDoc: async, batch. Middleware: SAP PI/PO, MuleSoft, Dell Boomi, Apache Camel.
distractor_pool.ERP_MES_Interface: Integration boundary between Level 4 (ERP) and Level 3 (MES). Key data flows: material master sync, production order download, goods movement posting, quality notification, equipment master. Protocols: B2MML/XML, OPC-UA Part 8, REST/JSON, RFC/BAPI (SAP), iDoc.
distractor_pool.ERP_MES_MaterialMasterSync: ERP→MES: material number, description, UoM, BOM, routing, quality specs. Sync patterns: full dump (initial), delta sync (change-based), event-driven (on material change). SAP: iDoc MATMAS, RFC BAPI_MATERIAL_GET_ALL.
distractor_pool.ERP_MES_ProductionOrder: ERP→MES: production order (material, quantity, due date, routing, BOM). MES→ERP: order confirmation (actual quantity, scrap, times, material consumption). SAP: iDoc LOIPRO (order), CO_OPER_CONFIRM (confirmation). B2MML: ProductionSchedule/ProductionPerformance.
distractor_pool.Enterprise_Integration: Integration of business (ERP L4), operations (MES/MOM L3), and control (SCADA/PLC L2) systems across ISA-95 levels using standards: OPC-UA, B2MML, MQTT/UNS, REST, MTConnect, PackML. Includes compliance (GMP/21CFR11), analytics, and data historian.
distractor_pool.Feedforward_Control: Open-loop compensation using disturbance model to preemptively adjust control signal; often combined with feedback
distractor_pool.GMP_Data_Integrity: ALCOA+: Attributable (who), Legible (readable), Contemporaneous (real-time), Original (source data), Accurate (correct). Plus: Complete, Consistent, Enduring, Available. Applies to all GxP data: process, quality, lab, distribution. Historian audit trail, MES data collection, LIMS results.
distractor_pool.GMP_Deep: Regulatory framework for pharma, food, medical device manufacturing. Ensures products are consistently produced and controlled per quality standards. Key regulations: FDA 21 CFR 210/211 (pharma), EU GMP Annex 11 (computerized systems), ICH Q7 (API). Affects MES/ERP integration via audit trails and electronic records.
distractor_pool.GMP_Electronic_Batch_Record: Paperless manufacturing record replacing paper batch records. Contains: master batch record (recipe/instructions), execution data (operator entries, process values, timestamps), deviations, signatures. MES generates EBR. Review-by-exception for efficiency. Critical for batch release.
distractor_pool.GMP_Validation_IQOQPQ: Installation Qualification (IQ): verify system installed per specs. Operational Qualification (OQ): verify system operates correctly in all anticipated ranges. Performance Qualification (PQ): verify system consistently performs in actual production conditions. Also: DQ (Design Qualification), CSV (Computerized System Validation), GAMP 5 risk-based approach.
distractor_pool.Galvanic_Isolation: Electrical isolation between circuits to prevent ground loops and protect equipment. Methods: optocoupler, transformer coupling, capacitive isolation
distractor_pool.HART_Protocol: Highway Addressable Remote Transducer. Hybrid analog+digital protocol superimposing FSK digital signal on 4-20mA loop. Enables bidirectional communication for device configuration and diagnostics
distractor_pool.Historian_Compression: Swinging Door Trending (SDT): deadband-based, keeps only significant changes. Lossy compression 10:1 to 40:1. Exception reporting: only send on deviation > deadband. Archive compression: further reduces stored points. Trade-off: storage vs fidelity.
distractor_pool.Historian_Data_Retrieval: Recorded values (raw compressed), interpolated values (fixed interval), plot values (min/max/avg per pixel), summary (aggregate statistics). PI SDK, PI Web API (REST). Time ranges, relative time (*-1h). Bulk retrieval for analytics/ML.
distractor_pool.ISA95_L3_L2_Information_Flow: Downward: work orders, recipes, setpoints, equipment commands. Upward: process data, equipment status, batch reports, alarms, production counts. Typically via OPC-UA or proprietary protocols.
distractor_pool.ISA95_L4_L3_Information_Flow: Downward: production orders, material definitions, quality parameters, schedule. Upward: production performance, quality results, inventory status, material consumption. Key B2MML schemas: ProductionSchedule, ProductionPerformance.
distractor_pool.ISA95_Level0_Physical_Process: Actual physical processes: chemical reactions, material transformation, energy conversion. Defines the process being controlled. Time horizon: continuous/real-time.
distractor_pool.ISA95_Level1_Sensing_Manipulating: Sensors, actuators, instruments. Activities: process variable measurement (temperature, pressure, flow), actuation (valve opening, motor speed). Devices: RTD, thermocouple, pressure transmitter, VFD.
distractor_pool.ISA95_Level2_Monitoring_Supervisory: SCADA, DCS, PLC-based control. Activities: real-time process monitoring, setpoint management, alarm handling, basic regulatory control (PID loops), sequence control, interlocking. Time horizon: seconds to minutes.
distractor_pool.ISA95_Level3_Manufacturing_Operations: MES/MOM functions. Activities: production scheduling, dispatching, quality management, inventory tracking, performance analysis, labor management, WIP tracking, recipe management. Time horizon: minutes to days.
distractor_pool.ISA95_Level4_Business_Planning: ERP functions. Activities: production planning, material procurement, order management, financial accounting, supply chain management, demand forecasting, master scheduling. Time horizon: days to months.
distractor_pool.ISA95_Level_Model_Deep: Detailed breakdown of ISA-95 five-level hierarchy: Level 0 (physical process), Level 1 (sensing/manipulating), Level 2 (monitoring/supervisory), Level 3 (manufacturing operations), Level 4 (business planning/logistics)
distractor_pool.InfluxDB_Industrial: Open-source time-series DB used as modern historian alternative. InfluxQL/Flux query language. Telegraf for data collection (OPC-UA, MQTT, Modbus plugins). Grafana for visualization. Retention policies for data lifecycle.
distractor_pool.Instrumentation_and_Control: Field of engineering dealing with measurement, signal conditioning, and control of industrial processes
distractor_pool.MOM_Deep: ISA-95 Part 3 defines four operations categories at Level 3. MOM is the superset concept; MES is the software implementing it. Each category has: definition management, resource management, detailed scheduling, dispatching, execution management, data collection, tracking, performance analysis.
distractor_pool.MOM_Inventory_Operations: WIP inventory tracking, material lot genealogy, material consumption recording, raw material staging, finished goods receipt. Provides real-time inventory visibility between ERP cycle counts.
